patch_description: Replace the greedy+full-insertion local search with a multi-strategy search: (1) greedy construction with a decaying exploration rate (0.95 → 0.7) to build diverse starting solutions, (2) simulated annealing over insertion/relocation moves with adaptive temperature so the search can escape local minima that pure insertion descent gets stuck in, and (3) iterative first-improvement descent with restarts from perturbed best solutions (basin hopping). Using annealing instead of strict descent lets the search traverse worse schedules to reach better basins, which should lower makespan further than the greedy + insertion local search.
